Wirus agresywnie atakuje komórki kości i: The virus aggressively attacks bone and tissue cells: severe pain, damage and bleeding.
Wirus agresywnie atakuje skórę i krew, p: The virus aggressively attacks the skin and blood, leading to extreme bleeding.
Wirus atakuje DNA nosiciela i wywołuje g: The virus attacks the host's DNA and causes violent mutations. It also raises body temperature, so the cryo cell stops helping.
Wirus atakuje układ ruchowy i wywołuje z: The virus attacks the motor system and causes dizziness. The host's vision shakes.
Wirus atakuje zdolność odróżniania lewej: The virus attacks the ability to tell left from right. The host walks where they don't want to.
Wirus blokuje usuwanie naturalnych toksy: The virus blocks the removal of natural toxins that accumulate in the host's body.
Wirus daje nosicielowi poczucie humoru,: The virus gives the host a sense of humor, whether they want it or not.
Wirus gwałtownie przyspiesza metabolizm: The virus causes the host's metabolism to accelerate rapidly, making them process chemicals twice as fast,but also causing increased hunger.
Wirus hamuje termoregulację, schładzając: The virus inhibits the body's thermoregulation, cooling the body down.
Wirus leczy ciało nosiciela, gdy ten prz: The virus is able to mend the host's flesh when in conditions of low light, repairing physical damage. More effective against brute damage.
Wirus lekko utrudnia oddychanie, przez c: The virus slightly impedes breathing, causing the host to wheeze.
Wirus ma bardzo słabe działanie, dopóki: The virus has very little effect until it reaches its final stage
Wirus ma silniejsze objawy. Może mieć ni: The virus has more powerful symptoms. May have unpredictable effects
Wirus mutuje metabolizm nosiciela, przez: The virus mutates the host's metabolism, making it almost unable to gain nutrition from food.
Wirus nadprodukuje czynniki krzepnięcia:: The virus overproduces clotting factors: it stops bleeding and quickly restores lost blood.
Wirus nadprodukuje komórki macierzyste u: The virus overproduces stem cells geared toward forming organs. The finished organs are pushed out of the body, and the host is injured in the process.
Wirus naśladuje działanie normalnych kom: The virus mimics the function of normal body cells, becoming harder to spot and to eradicate, but reducing its speed. This symptom discourages disease mutation
Wirus niszczy komórki barwnikowe skóry,: The virus destroys skin pigment cells, causing rapid loss of pigmentation in the host.
Wirus osłabia budowę ciała. Każda część: The virus weakens the body's structure. Every body part withstands less and less damage.
Wirus osłabia skórę nosiciela. Pęka ona: The virus weakens the host's skin. It tears at every collision and touch.
Wirus pobiera plazmę z otoczenia, z butl: The virus draws plasma from the environment, from canisters and from the host's blood to heal damage and equalize body temperature.
Wirus pobudza organizm do wytwarzania an: The virus stimulates the body to produce antitoxin, which cleanses the blood and liver.
Wirus pobudza ośrodek przyjemności. Nosi: The virus stimulates the pleasure center. The host feels wonderful.
Wirus pobudza szybki wzrost komórek w tk: The virus stimulates rapid cell growth in organ tissues, slowly repairing the host's organs over time.
Wirus pobudza wzrost komórek i leczy obr: The virus stimulates cell growth and heals physical damage and burns, but the repair leaves toxins in the body.
Wirus pobudza ślinianki. Nosiciel się śl: The virus stimulates the salivary glands. The host drools.
Wirus podrażnia gardło nosiciela, powodu: The virus irritates the throat of the host, causing occasional coughing.
Wirus podrażnia jamę nosową, przez co no: The virus causes irritation of the nasal cavity, making the host sneeze occasionally.
Wirus podrażnia kanaliki łzowe. Nosiciel: The virus irritates the tear ducts. The host's eyes water.
Wirus podrażnia nerwy ruchowe. Nosiciel: The virus irritates the motor nerves. The host twitches involuntarily.
Wirus podrażnia skórę, powodując swędzen: The virus irritates the skin, causing itching.
Wirus potrafi manipulować metalem i zwią: The virus can manipulate metal and silicate compounds, becoming able to infect robotic beings. The virus also provides a suitable substrate for nanites in otherwise inhospitable hosts
Wirus potrafi przetrwać i namnażać się n: The virus can survive and replicate even in an inorganic environment, increasing its resistance and infection rate.
Wirus potrafi rozwijać się i działać naw: The virus is able to thrive and act even within dead hosts.
Wirus powoduje kurczenie się płuc nosici: The virus causes shrinking of the host's lungs, causing severe asphyxiation. May also lead to heart attacks.
Wirus powoduje niepokój, nerwowość i nad: The virus causes restlessness, nervousness and hyperactivity, increasing the rate at which the host needs to eat,but making them harder to tire out
Wirus powoduje szybką utratę włosów na g: The virus causes rapid shedding of head and body hair.
Wirus powoduje zaburzenia hormonalne, pr: The virus causes a hormone imbalance, making the host sleepy and narcoleptic.
Wirus powoduje zapalenie błon bębenkowyc: The virus causes inflammation of the eardrums, causing intermittent deafness.
Wirus poświęca długoterminową przeżywaln: The virus sacrifices its long term survivability to nearly instantly fully spread inside a host. The virus will start at the last stage, but will eventually decay and die off by itself.
Wirus przebudowuje ciało nosiciela w jas: The virus remodels the host's body into a lizard. After being cured, the host returns to their original species.
Wirus przebudowuje ciało nosiciela w ćmę: The virus remodels the host's body into a moth. After being cured, the host returns to their original species.
Wirus przyczepia się do gruczołów potowy: The virus attaches to sudoriparous glands, synthesizing a chemical that bursts into flames when reacting with water, leading to self-immolation.
Wirus przyspiesza naturalne gojenie, prz: The virus accelerates the body's natural healing, causing the body to heal minor wounds quickly. Causes heavy scarring.
Wirus reaguje na bezpośrednie światło gw: The virus reacts to direct starlight, producing regenerative chemicals. Works best against toxin-based damage.
Wirus reaguje na nanity w krwiobiegu nos: The virus reacts to nanites in the host's bloodstream by attacking and consuming them. May also cause nanites to go haywire. Damages the host's mechanical limbs
The virus reacts to nanites in the host's bloodstream by enhancing their replication cycle. May cause unpredictable nanite behaviour. Heals the host's mechanical limbs
Wirus rozkręca w ciele nosiciela nieustę: The virus winds up a relentless rhythm in the host's body. At first only strange feelings and shortness of breath, then fever and fire, and in the end the body can't take the rhythm and explodes.
Wirus rozpuszcza mięśnie twarzy. Nosicie: The virus liquefies the facial muscles. The host becomes unrecognizable.
Wirus rozregulowuje ośrodek strachu. Nos: The virus dysregulates the fear center. The host has panic attacks, and in the last stage coughs up butterflies.
Wirus rośnie na każdej powierzchni, na j: The virus will grow on any surfaces it can, such as the host's skin, or even the ground, should the host remain stationary
Wirus rośnie w nosicielu, przestając być: The virus grows within the host, ceasing to be microscopic and causing severe bodily harm. These Phages will seek out, attack, and infect more viable hosts
Wirus sprawia, że na skórze nosiciela ro: The virus causes the host to grow egg-like nodules on their skin, which periodically fall off and contain the disease and some healing chemicals.
Wirus sprawia, że na świetle mięśnie się: The virus will cause muscles to contract when exposed to light, resulting in lowered speed, but increased durability. Muscles will become more malleable in the darkness, resulting in the host moving faster, but being more easily bruised.
Wirus sprawia, że nosicielowi nieprzewid: The virus causes the host to unpredictably grow and shed sharp spines, damaging those near them.
Wirus sprawia, że przy ciężkich obrażeni: The virus causes the host to fall into a death-like coma when severely damaged, then rapidly fixes the damage. Only fixes burn and brute damage.
Wirus sprawia, że zarażone komórki obumi: The virus causes infected cells to die off when exposed to radiation, causing open wounds to appear on the host's flesh. The end result of this process is the removal of radioactive contamination from the host.
Wirus stymuluje mózg, powodując okazjona: The virus stimulates the brain, causing occasional hallucinations.
Wirus stymuluje wytwarzanie i wymianę tk: The virus stimulates the production and replacement of sensory tissues, causing the host to regenerate eyes and ears when damaged.
Wirus syntetyzuje w ciele nosiciela „cie: The virus synthesizes a \"thin mint\" in the host's body: a substance that messes with the head.
Wirus syntetyzuje w ciele olej i inne ma: The virus synthesizes oil and other inorganic materials in the body, which the host expels. Rarely a whole robot jumps out of the mouth.
Wirus szybko pochłania zarażone komórki,: The virus rapidly consumes infected cells, leading to heavy and widespread damage. Contains dormant prions- expert virologists believe it to be the precursor to Romerol, though the mechanism through which they are activated is largely unknown
Wirus szybko przystosowuje się do jak na: The virus quickly adapts to spread as fast as possible both outside and inside a host. This, however, makes the virus easier to spot, and less able to fight off a cure. This symptom encourages disease mutation
Wirus szybko rozkłada wszelkie obce subs: The virus rapidly breaks down any foreign chemicals in the bloodstream.
Wirus szybko syntetyzuje tlen, praktyczn: The virus rapidly synthesizes oxygen, effectively removing the need for breathing.
Wirus uszkadza naczynia w nosie. Nosicie: The virus damages the vessels in the nose. The host gets nosebleeds, and the blood may carry the virus.
Wirus wchodzi w symbiozę z ważnymi organ: The virus forms a symbiotic relationship with vital organs in the host's body, accelerating the host's natural healing processes while resting.
Wirus wyczula nosiciela na bóle i zakwas: The virus sensitizes the host to aches and soreness, making them tire faster.
Wirus wykorzystuje wodę w ciele i na nim: The virus uses excess water inside and outside the body to repair damaged tissue cells. More effective when using holy water and against burns.
Wirus wywołuje fermentację w żołądku, pr: The virus causes fermentation in the stomach, leading to chronic drunkenness.
Wirus wywołuje masową histerię wokół los: The virus causes mass hysteria involving a random concept.
Wirus wywołuje mdłości i podrażnia żołąd: The virus causes nausea and irritates the stomach, causing occasional vomit.
Wirus wywołuje ropiejące zakażenia węzłó: The virus causes festering infections in the host's lymph nodes, leading to festering buboes that deal toxin damage.
Wirus wywołuje stan zapalny w mózgu, pow: The virus causes inflammation inside the brain, causing constant headaches.
Wirus wywołuje u nosiciela reakcję gorąc: The virus causes a febrile response from the host, raising its body temperature.
Wirus wywołuje zapalenie błędnika. Nosic: The virus causes inflammation of the vestibular system, leading to bouts of dizziness.
Wirus wywołuje zapalenie siatkówki, prow: The virus causes inflammation of the retina, leading to eye damage and eventually blindness.
Wirus wzmacnia połączenia między neurona: The virus strengthens the bonds between neurons, reducing the duration of any ailments of the mind.
Wirus zagnieżdża się w ośrodkach społecz: Infests the social structures of the infected's brain, causing them to feel better in crowds of other potential victims, and punishing them for being alone.
Wirus zakłóca prawidłową pracę układu ne: The virus interferes with the proper function of the neural system, leading to bouts of confusion and erratic movement.
Wirus zamienia tłuszcz w niezwykle łatwo: The virus turns fat into an extremely flammable compound, and raises the body's temperature, making the host burst into flames spontaneously.
Wirus zastępuje melaninę w skórze reakty: The virus replaces the melanin in the skin with reactive pigment.
Wirus zawiera utajone plany DNA do stwor: The virus contains latent DNA blueprints to create a toxin-devouring grub egg, which parasitizes slimes and slime people. Its normally toxic, infectious flesh becomes safe and delicious when cooked.
Wirus zmienia wysokość i barwę strun gło: The virus alters the pitch and tone of the host's vocal cords, changing how their voice sounds.
Wirus znacznie zwiększa produkcję włosów: The virus increases hair production significantly, causing rapid beard growth.
Wirus zwiększa wytwarzanie komórek barwn: The virus causes increased production of skin pigment cells, making the host's skin grow darker over time.
Wirus łączy się symbiotycznie z komórkam: The virus becomes symbiotically connected to the cells in the host's body, preventing and reversing aging. The virus, in turn, becomes more resistant, spreads faster, and is harder to spot, although it doesn't thrive as well without a host.
Wirus łączy się z DNA nosiciela, powoduj: The virus bonds with the DNA of the host, causing damaging mutations until removed.
An apparently sentient virus, extremely adaptable and resistant to outside sources of mutation.

Wpis 1:<br>Dostaliśmy dziś obiecany zrzu:
Log 1:
We got our promised supply drop today. We were only meant to get it, what, a week ago? This bloody gateway keeps desyncing itself, and that means subsisting off recycled water and carb packs. No clue where the damn thing connects to on its off days, and HQ say we are 'not to touch it if it isn't linking to command.' We dumped off the assload of crates Jim filled, got our boxes of oxygen, food and drink, and closed the portal.

Log 2:
Damn thing is acting up again. Three days no contact this time. I thought I heard clanking noises from it yesterday. Jim is going on about the NT base or some shit. We've been over this before - They don't know we're here, that engineer was too drunk to recognize his suit, especially since I had it painted orange. He's starting to get annoying. We're safe.

Log 3:
Gateway synced itself up automatically today. I opened it for an instant to spy through it, got a glimpse of the inside of a transport container. Either HQ's redecorating or something, or there's more than two of these things.
Wpis 1:<br>Podczas dzisiejszego wydobyci:
Log 1:
While mining today I noticed the NT station was finished with its renovations. They placed some huge reinforced tumor on the station, looks so ugly. I wouldn't be surprised if those pigs decided to turn that little astronomy outpost into a prison with that thing, it'd be pretty typical of them.

Log 2:
Really dumb of me but I just waved at an engineer in the outpost, and he waved back. I hope to god he was too dumb or drunk to recognize the suit, because if he isn't then we might have to pull out before they come looking for us.

Log 3:
That huge reinforced tumor in their science section has been making a lot of noise lately. I've been hearing some banging and scratching from the other side and I'm kind of glad now that they reinforced this thing so much. I'll be sleeping with my gun under my pillow from now on.
Wpis pierwszy - 27/05/2554:<br>Dopiero p:
Entry One - 27/05/2554:
I just arrived, and already I hate my job. I'm stuck on this shithole of an outpost, trying to avoid these damn eggheads running all over the place preparing for god knows what. There's no crimes to stop, no syndies to kill, and I'm not even allowed to beat the fuckin' assistant senseless! They said I was transferred from Space Station 13 for 'good behavior', but this feels more like a punishment than a reward. All I know is that if I don't get some action soon, I'm going to go insane.

Entry Two - 03/06/2554:
Okay, so get this: we got a fuckin' deathsquad coming in today! I thought the day I saw one of them would be the day my employment was 'terminated', if you get my drift. They're escorting some sort of weird alien creature for the eggheads to study. I heard one of the docs telling the chef that this thing killed a whole security force before it was captured. I sure as hell hope that I don't have to fight it.

Entry Three - 08/06/2554:
My first real bit of 'action' today, if you could call it that. Crazy Ivan got in a fight with Kuester today about his Booze-O-Mat. Apparently one of the crewmembers had stolen a couple bottles of booze from the machine after Ivan disabled the ID lock. Tell you the truth, I don't blame the thief. Everyone is going a little stir-crazy in here, and the bartender is being damn stingy with the alcohol. Either way, once they started to pick a fight, I had to take them down. It's a damn shame that we don't have a brig, though. I had to lock Ivan in a fuckin' freezer, for god's sake. Let's hope that we can keep our sanity together, at least for a while.

Entry Four - 10/06/2554:
Jesus fucking Christ riding on a motorbike. These things the scientists are studying are terrifying! Fucking great huge purple bug things as tall as the ceiling, with blades for arms and drooling at the mouth. I don't think my taser will do jack shit against these damn things, but the eggheads say that they're safely contained. If they do, I have a feeling that it's only a matter of time before we're all screwed. These bastards look like walking death.

Entry Five - 18/06/2554:
Finally caught who stole the booze from Kuester. It was that fuckin' loser assistant Steve! He was in the dorms, chugging his worries away. I took one of the bottles back to the barkeep, but no one has to know about this second one. I think I'm gonna enjoy this while watching tomorrow's Thunderdome match.

Entry Six - 19/06/2554:
Oh, great. The chef is still sleeping, so we get Ivan's gruel for breakfast today. I overheard Sano and Douglas saying something about the aliens being restless, so we might get some action today. As long as it happens after the big game, I'm fine with it. I still got one beer to drink before I'm ready to die.

Zestaw stawia główny rdzeń danych z SI (: The kit places the main data core with an AI (the \"test AI\" is already inside, without a player: take it over as an admin, e.g. Possess on a mob), a second core (backup), cabinets, a rack assembler, consoles and ethernet cables under the whole arena. The cores have a battery. In the \"RAM materials\" crate there are an advanced processor, 50 iron and glass, silver, gold, a control code and a spare captain's card (RD/CE access). 1) Take over the AI → expected: the AI sits in the main core, there is a processing panel button on the HUD. Resource distribution console (card in hand) → allocate all free CPU and RAM to the AI: the prefilled cabinet gives 1 THz and 1 TB in total. 2) Processing panel: allocate CPU to a project and run a completed project → expected: free CPU gives AI research points, the project changes state (e.g. camera speedup). 3) Rack assembler: insert a regular processor (1 THz), add 1 TB of RAM (1 glass + 1 iron, pour in sheets from the crate) and build → expected: a 1 THz / 1 TB rack (examine). Put the rack into an empty cabinet → the total in the distribution console rises by 1 THz and 1 TB. Negative: a second processor in the same rack → \"This slot has not been researched yet!\". 4) Overclocking station: overclock a processor → expected: the result of the attempt (successful or not) and a change of the processor's clock/power draw in examine. 5) Destroy the main core (e.g. VV/Delete or a heavy hammer) → expected: the AI moves to the backup core, it does not die. Negative: remove the backup too → the AI dies, an intellicard with its save drops out. 6) AI control console (RD/CE card or a code from paper): insert an intellicard, download the AI onto the card → expected: the AI disappears from the core and from the allocation list, it is on the card; upload it back → it returns to the core. The MMI variant requires a player in the brain (requires a ghost/second player: put the brain in an MMI and give it to the player); without a brain with a mind the console refuses: \"brain inactive!\". 7) The AI core screen shows the AI's face. Heat: raise the air temperature near the core above 15°C (VV the gas, 300 K) → expected: the core/cabinet stop working and the AI loses resources; turn on the server room chiller (a click sets the temperature) → approx. 5°C on its tile and the neighboring ones, the machines return to work.

Kill it → it stays where it fell, it does not slide away; drag a dead one and a living one (the living one does not break free on its own), butcher it. Zestaw: plecak odrzutowy, hardsuit inżyn: Kit: jetpack, engineering hardsuit, radiation suit and hood, Geiger counter, plutonium rod, potassium iodide bottle, health analyzer, syringe, toxin bottle, burger, cola, ID console, NtOS command console (ID card program), CentCom console, captain's spare ID, CentCom ID and a blank ID. 1) Jetpack: put on the jetpack, turn it on and go out into space. Flying uses fuel (gas analyzer on the tank: it drops with every step in vacuum), in gravity it uses none. With stabilizers the character stops after releasing the key, without them they keep drifting. Empty tank → the jetpack turns off (negative). A jetpack held in hand has no toggle button (negative). Release a pulled object while flying → it keeps flying. The space background scrolls smoothly; FTL jump and the pilot's overmap view unchanged. 2) Access: insert the captain's ID and the blank ID into the ID console → 8 station groups in Polish, toggling a single access works. Give the blank ID the MAA assignment, log out and log in with the MAA ID → it only sees Uzbrojenie and cannot grant Captain access (negative). Demote a Majtek → works. On the command console open the ID card program and log in with the captain's ID → the groups show up immediately (without reopening the window), „Nadaj region” grants the clicked department. On the CentCom console with the CentCom ID: Centrala and Inne groups. 3) Stomach: eat the burger and drink the cola, scan with the analyzer → reagents in the „Zawartość żołądka” section, in the blood after about 40 s. Inject 10 u of toxin with the syringe → in the blood immediately, the liver takes damage; 2 u of toxin in food → no effect. Vomit → it drains from the stomach, not from the blood. 4) Radiation: stand next to the plutonium rod without protection → the Geiger counter clicks and shows the level, a scan shows the irradiation percentage; from 20% glow and an alert. In the full radiation suit → no increase; in the engineering hardsuit with helmet too. The suit alone without the helmet does not protect (negative). Walk away → the percentage drops on its own by about 0.1%/s, faster with potassium iodide. A wall between you and the rod weakens the pulse.

Deconstructing the chair and table returns the gold. 2) Girder + 2 sheets of plastic, wood or meat → coloured, opaque wall without a black wedge; glass makes a see-through wall; cloth does nothing (negative). 3) Eat a meat sheet, a meat floor and a meat wall → plating remains. 4) Meat slab into the Sheetifier → 4 meat sheets with an animation. 5) Coins: swipe a coin over the ID card → value matches the material, tokens 0 cr; the arcade token does not slip; flipping a coin shows heads/tails. 6) A plasma stack explodes in fire, a bananium sheet squeaks and slips. 7) Metalgen on a stack and a coin → no change (negative). 8) The autolathe accepts wood, meat and bluespace; fabricator windows show wood, meat and adamantine icons. 9) Mapped walls and toolboxes look as before, assemblies and signalers are not tinted or translucent.
Zestaw: skrzynia-mimik, ludzka muchołówk:
Kit: crate mimic, venus human trap, kudzu flower bud, creature, mi-go, blank body, wumborian fugu, space dragon, plus a toolbox mimic and a laser mimic (from setup()). All of them attack on their own, do not drop them together with the peaceful kit. Check both control modes (combat mode and the old intents). \
	1) The crate stands still; try to open it with an empty hand without combat mode / on the help intent -> "starts to move", it bites and opens its lid. After death a normal crate with its contents is left. \
	2) The toolbox mimic chases and hits, slowly loses health without a target; after death the toolbox is left. The laser mimic shoots from range, once its battery is empty it comes close and hits. \
	3) The venus human trap grabs with a vine from up to 4 tiles (2 s knockdown, leash), bites and heals with every bite. The bud grows a new trap after 2 minutes. Possess the trap: a click out of reach in combat mode / on the harm intent tangles the target, without combat mode it does not. \
	4) The creature, mi-go and blank body hit harder (the creature and mi-go are also faster) at low health; the mi-go dodges sideways and makes random sounds. Possess the creature: "Uncanny Movement" works only when nobody sees you (6 s standing still), then you pass through walls. \
	5) The fugu runs away, with a target it inflates for 10 s: large, immortal, bites and tears down normal walls. The gland of a dead fugu used on another animal (basic mobs too) makes it bigger and stronger. \
	6) Dragon: possess it. You pick the colour when you enter. Click out of reach -> fire breath (30 burn damage, stops at walls, windows and closed doors); right click out of reach / disarm intent -> wing buffet (throws back and knocks down, further uses tire you longer); the action button does the same. Click a wall -> tears it down (4 s, reinforced 12 s). Click a corpse -> swallows it in 3 s and heals; revived corpses are spat out, everything falls out when the dragon dies. The dragon's fire on carp speeds them up for 8 s. \
	7) Antagonist: give the dragon the "Space Dragon" role from the player panel, go to one of the areas from the objective and use "Summon Rift" -> carp rift (10 s). Ghosts can come out of it as carp, and the dragon heals standing next to it.

Zmiany trzeba robić na samym statku, nie: Make the changes on the ship itself, not in the chamber (the chamber is not on a ship level). 1) On the ship: tear down a few walls, including a wall with an alarm or intercom and a hull wall to space, break a window next to space, build a new wall on a tile with an item, lay a cable and a pipe, burn or break a piece of floor. Machines: deconstruct a machine or a gun, move and wrench a vending machine or a console somewhere else, rotate a console, build a new machine with upgraded parts. Also remove the helm or the communications console (critical machines). 2) Admin > Server > Ship Structure: saving after this round must be YES. End the round with a normal round end (not a hard restart). 3) Next round, same map: walls, windows, cables, pipes and floor damage come back. The hull hole and the broken window are sealed with foam, the alarm or intercom hangs on a neighbouring wall, the item from the new wall lies next to it. The deconstructed machine does not come back, the moved one stands where it was left (no duplicate on the old spot), the rotation stays, the new machine keeps its upgrades. The helm or communications console stands on its map spot. Items in lockers and vending machines are as on the map, and loose equipment (IV drips, canisters) is back in its places. 4) Ship Structure shows how many tiles were restored and skipped. Delete the save: the next round starts on the ship straight from the map. 5) Destroying the ship or Hard restart + new campaign also deletes the save.

Here is a list of words you can type into the 'Announcement' button to create sentences to vocally announce to everyone on the same level at you.
  • You can also click on the word to PREVIEW it.
  • You can only say 30 words for every announcement.
  • Do not use punctuation as you would normally, if you want a pause you can use the full stop and comma characters by separating them with spaces, like so: 'Alpha . Test , Bravo'.

  • Sound effects begin with an 's' before the actual word, e.g. scensor
  • Use Ctrl+F to see if a word exists in the list.

	SAY The NSV Galactica is a ship of war. You are unlikely to find luxury amenities here, it's built for one purpose, at which it excels.
	DELAY 20
	SAY The NSV Galactica is equipped with 4 main batteries, featuring 8 NT-BSG gauss guns, 6 NT-HOOD naval artillery cannon and an experimental Bluespace Artillery.
	DELAY 30
	SAY Alongside its impressive physical artillery, the bluespace artillery beam is a new breakthrough in bluespace technology, and does not in-fact violate any SolGov sanctions!
	DELAY 30
	SAY The Galactica was built in direct response to Syndicate aggression and is equipped to level colonies and entire fleets alike.
	DELAY 30
	SAY That concludes our miniseries on technical specs, enjoy the rest of the museum!
	DELAY 30
	SAY END OF RECORDING. PLEASE INSERT NEXT FLOPPY DISK.

SAY LOADING INFORMATIONAL HOLOTAPE #2
	SAY WELCOME TO THE SOLARIA.
	NAME Joe 'Schlomo' Speedwagon
	SAY Welcome to the SGV Solaria! I'm Joe, and I'll be your guide.
	DELAY 30
	SAY This is the second installment of several informational holotapes recorded by VICKER media on behalf of the Solarian Government.
	DELAY 30
	SAY The Solaria participated in many border skirmishes, however as she was created primarily as a peacekeeping ship, she rarely saw heavy combat.
	DELAY 30
	SAY Most famously, the Solaria dealt a crushing blow to the Jovian felinid-abduction rings, taking on an entire fleet of transport ships by itself!
	DELAY 30
	SAY Unfortunately, that's all I've got time for today. Tune in to the next installment to find out all about the Solaria's technical specifications. For now, goodbye! And please, enjoy the museum...
	DELAY 30
	SAY END OF RECORDING. PLEASE INSERT NEXT FLOPPY DISK.

SAY LOADING INFORMATIONAL HOLOTAPE #3
	SAY WELCOME TO THE SOLARIA.
	NAME Joe 'Schlomo' Speedwagon
	SAY Welcome to the SGV Solaria! I'm Joe, and I'll be your guide.
	DELAY 30
	SAY This is the final installment of several informational holotapes recorded by VICKER media on behalf of the Solarian Government.
	DELAY 30
	SAY Last installment, I told you all about the Solaria's rich history, but now it's time to talk tech!
	DELAY 30
	SAY The Solaria boasts 8 Gauss cannon, 4 electromagnetic railguns, and even more torpedo tubes!
	DELAY 30
	SAY She's rated to withstand a thermonuclear blast of up to 200MT, though this has never been tested!
	DELAY 30
	SAY The Solaria is capable of long range faster-than-light travel, and boasted an experimental class 2 stormdrive at its peak, capable of delivering megawatts of power! Though unfortunately, after decomissioning, the Solaria's stormdrive was replaced with a more stable fission reactor.
	DELAY 30
	SAY Thank you for joining me on this journey, and hopefully your quest for knowledge doesn't end here! There's plenty of reading material for you around the museum, or you can look at some of the ship's departments - preserved exactly as they would've been used 30 years ago!.
	DELAY 30
	SAY This is me, Joe Speedwagon, Signing off.
	SAY END OF SERIES.

text: 'Dobrze znosisz chłód i niskie ciś: text: 'You tolerate cold and low pressure well, but extreme cold and vacuum hurt you. This does not affect you inside a host, and a spacesuit will protect the host.',
text: 'Dorosły robak może się rozmnożyć:: text: 'An adult worm can reproduce: 3 new larvae come out of the cocoon, and you yourself return to larva form.',
text: 'Drabina to najbezpieczniejszy spo: text: 'The ladder represents the safest way to disconnect before the cache is recovered. Should your connection sever, the netpod offers limited resuscitation potential.',
text: 'Gdy zostanie ci mniej niż 10% zdr: text: 'If less than 10% of your health remains in the blood, the host will eject you. It is a chance to escape at the last moment.',
text: 'Każda udzielona lekcja dodaje nam: text: 'Every lesson given adds to our strength. With right click we can turn walls into glass to reach even further.',
text: 'Koniec rundy został opóźniony. Ch: text: 'The round end was delayed, would you like to start Battle Royale?',
text: 'Korporacja DeForest stworzyła jed: text: 'The DeForest Corporation has created single-use testers that detect blood worms. Security can order them from cargo. They work instantly, but they hurt and are expensive.',
text: 'Larwy chodzą rurami wentylacji. P: text: 'Larvae travel through ventilation pipes. After maturing you lose this ability and are left with slipping under doors, breaking doors down and ID access. Before you mature, find a good spot or a host.',
text: 'Leczenie nosiciela w medbayu zami: text: 'Healing a host in medbay instead of with your own blood does not leave them deathly pale and saves blood for spitting and healing.',
text: 'Lodówki z krwią w medbayu to niez: text: 'Blood fridges in medbay are a decent source of synthetic blood when there are no monkeys. Be careful, breaking a fridge can be heard through walls.',
text: 'Mały zasięg ataku i znikome obraż: text: 'Short attack range and negligible damage, but great for quick escapes and repositioning.',
text: 'Możesz wyjść z nosiciela, by kogo: text: 'You can leave a host to surprise someone, especially as an adult. Cut off escape routes first, because exiting takes 3 seconds.',
text: 'Nie musisz oddychać. Dotyczy to t: text: 'You do not need to breathe. This applies to your hosts as well.',
text: 'Nosiciel nie potrzebuje oddychać: text: 'A host does not need to breathe or have a working heart and liver, a brain is enough. You can revive a dead host with its own blood.',
text: 'Nosicielom brakuje twoich zmysłów: text: 'Hosts lack your senses, so darkness and flashbangs affect them normally. Night vision goggles, eye protection and ear protection will help.',
text: 'Ochrona cię złapała? Z aktywnym P: text: 'Caught by security? With Blood Spit active, right click dissolves handcuffs, straitjackets and even locker hinges. You can also leave the host and escape through the vents or through the door.',
text: 'Pamiętaj, że jesteś fizycznie poł: text: 'Remember that you are physically linked to this presence. You are a foreign body in a hostile environment. It will attempt to forcefully eject you.',
text: 'Po podłączeniu jesteś w miarę bez: text: 'While connected, you are somewhat safe from environmental hazards and intrusions, but not completely. Pay close attention to alerts.',
text: 'Postęp wzrostu widać na przycisku: text: 'Growth progress is visible on the maturation button and when hovering over the worm icon in the top right corner. Once you have grown, seal yourself in a cocoon to advance to the next stage. A young worm spits blood, and an adult is extremely strong.',
text: 'Potrafisz zamienić się w krew i w: text: 'You can turn into blood and enter a human corpse, making it your host. You can also drag yourself onto a corpse.',
text: 'Powoli się leczysz, z progu śmier: text: 'You heal slowly, from the brink of death to full health in about 5 minutes. In a host this means slowly regaining blood. By injecting blood you quickly heal the host at the cost of your own health.',
text: 'Rośniesz, pijąc krew Wysysaniem k: text: 'You grow by drinking blood with Blood Drain or by entering corpses. Synthetic blood, e.g. from monkeys and blood bags, counts towards growth only up to a certain limit. The HUD shows the blood level of everyone, and examining a target tells you how much blood they have and how much they would give you.',
text: 'Tworzenie awatarów zżera ogromną: text: 'Generating avatars costs tremendous bandwidth. Do not waste them.',
text: 'Twój umysł nie jest ludzki. Nie z: text: 'Your mind is not human. You know no fear, even in a host.',
text: 'W kosmosie jesteś niewidzialny i: text: 'In space you are invisible and your wounds heal. You pass freely through glass, but an electrified grille will stop you.',
text: 'W nosicielu cały jesteś krwią, wi: text: 'Inside a host you are entirely blood, so their bleeding hurts you directly. Hosts also bleed after death and 50% faster than normal humans.',
text: 'Wnikając w zwłoki, błyskawicznie: text: 'By entering a corpse, you instantly drink all of its blood. Blood obtained while already in a host does not count towards growth.',
text: 'Wpatruj się w ofiarę, która cię w: text: 'Stare at a victim who sees you to stun and weaken them. This is how you give away your presence.',
text: 'Wysysasz powietrze prosto z płuc: text: 'You suck the air straight out of their lungs and quickly take down even the strongest. If they resist, right click deals normal damage. Your hands are only good for carrying things.',
text: 'Zanieś skrzynię na wyznaczone mie: text: 'Bring the crate to the designated sending location in the safehouse. The area may seem out of place. Examine the safehouse to find it.',
text: 'Zbadaj okolicę i zrób, co trzeba,: text: 'Study the area and do what needs to be done to recover the crate. Pay close attention to domain information and context clues.',
text: 'Źle znosisz wysoką temperaturę i: text: 'You tolerate high temperatures poorly and burn up quickly in them. This also applies inside a host, unless you dress them in a fireproof outfit.',

Nuclear Explosives 101:
Hello and thank you for choosing the Syndicate for your nuclear information needs.
Today's crash course will deal with the operation of a Fusion Class Nanotrasen made Nuclear Device.
First and foremost, DO NOT TOUCH ANYTHING UNTIL THE BOMB IS IN PLACE.
Pressing any button on the compacted bomb will cause it to extend and bolt itself into place.
If this is done to unbolt it one must completely log in which at this time may not be possible.
To make the nuclear device functional:
  • Place the nuclear device in the designated detonation zone.
  • Extend and anchor the nuclear device from its interface.
  • Insert the nuclear authorisation disk into slot.
  • Type numeric authorisation code into the keypad. This should have been provided. Note: If you make a mistake press R to reset the device.
  • Press the E button to log onto the device.
    • You now have activated the device. To deactivate the buttons at anytime for example when you've already prepped the bomb for detonation remove the auth disk OR press the R on the keypad.
    Now the bomb CAN ONLY be detonated using the timer. Manual detonation is not an option.
    Note: Nanotrasen is a pain in the neck.
    Toggle off the SAFETY.
    Note: You wouldn't believe how many Syndicate Operatives with doctorates have forgotten this step.
    So use the - - and + + to set a det time between 5 seconds and 10 minutes.
    Then press the timer toggle button to start the countdown.
    Now remove the auth. disk so that the buttons deactivate.
    Note: THE BOMB IS STILL SET AND WILL DETONATE
    Now before you remove the disk if you need to move the bomb you can:
    Toggle off the anchor, move it, and re-anchor.

    Good luck. Remember the order:
    Disk, Code, Safety, Timer, Disk, RUN!
    Intelligence Analysts believe that normal Nanotrasen procedure is for the Captain to secure the nuclear authorisation disk.
    Good luck!
